mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `auction_item`) AS itemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order_info` WHERE status IN (2, 3)) AS completedOrderCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(final_price), 0) FROM `order_info` WHERE status IN (2, 3, 4, 5)) AS gmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order_info`) AS totalOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bid_record`) AS totalBidCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `auction_item` WHERE status = 1) AS activeItemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order_info` WHERE status = 4) AS pendingRefundCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(register_time, '%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `user` WHERE register_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(register_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(register_time)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `auction_item` GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT c.category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `auction_item` i JOIN `category` c ON i.category_id = c.id WHERE c.parent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(final_price), 0) AS amount FROM `order_info` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(create_time)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order_info` GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT i.title, i.view_count, c.category_name AS category FROM `auction_item` i LEFT JOIN `category` c ON i.category_id = c.id ORDER BY i.view_count DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
